Key.English: Shows what this object holds at once, without a search. Overrides the server's search settings.
Fades everything whose name does not match. Escape empties it.
Goes to the first free spot - the folded rows too
%1 put on the ground - no room any more
Several items: no turning, whole stacks
Several items cannot go into one slot
Goes to the first free spot of this box - not onto a hidden item
Point at an item to see what it is
You may only look at this person's gear
Moved %1 of %2 - no room for the rest
A backpack does not go into a backpack
Nothing to put it on here
Waiting for the server - try again in a moment
No container has room for that
Put elsewhere - that place was just taken
Waiting for your hands - click to cancel
%1 went back - no room any more
%1 selected - drag them together, double click to move them over, the drop key drops them
holds one item, whatever its size
Let go to move it to this hotbar slot
Let go here to take it off the hotbar
Let go to leave it where it is
%1 is too far away - he has to stand next to you
Whitelisted: can be used from the %1
Hidden: kept out of the %1, so nothing else can use it
Still waiting for an answer - showing what is there
3D needs Picture-in-Picture - turn it on in the video options
Drag to turn, middle button to move, wheel to zoom, double click to reset
Drops the item under the mouse or the whole selection onto the ground.\nOver a worn slot it takes the item off; on a hotbar slot or ACE Arsenal's panel it empties/takes it out.
Moves the item under the mouse over, as a double click does; selected items move together.\nOpens a uniform, vest or backpack lying in a container.
Turns the item you are dragging a quarter round.
Highlights, switches, bars and the icons that are on.
The empty grid cells and the slot boxes, and how see-through they are. Kept dark enough for what lies on them to stay readable.
Your colours as text, copied to the clipboard - paste them anywhere to share your look.
Runs from the Start colour into the End colour, left to right. Click a box to pick its colour.
A colour code such as #FF8800 or #F80. Press Return to apply.
Paste colours someone exported (Ctrl+V) and press Apply.
The hairlines, and a frame round the panels, the slot boxes and the item tiles.
The window's background and how see-through it is. Kept dark so text stays readable.
The colours this part's gradient runs between. Unset, it takes the main gradient's start and end.
Whether this part runs in a gradient - the same as its checkbox. Off, it shows in its own colour, where you set one, or as before.
Back to the main gradient's colours for this part.
This part's own colours: the left half its start, the right its end. Click to set it below
Rounds like 30/30 on the magazines' tiles.
The weight bar, the ammo bars on magazines and the bars on the cards.
The window's buttons: Take all, Sort, the tabs' chips. Never those of the colour and sound panels.
Primary, Headgear, Uniform and the other captions over or in the slots.
The surfaces of buttons and chips: Open, Unload, Sort, the caption chips.
Your gear, Loot and the names of the boxes at the top of a column.
The name of what you point at, the comparison card and the tips of the buttons.
The keys and words in the bar at the bottom: Esc Close, F Quick move.
The weapons' 1, 2, 3, the hotbar's 4 to 0 and the page marks.
The line under a header button that is on (the palette, the speaker).
The rows of the menu a right click opens.
The names on the tiles, on the inspect card and in a vehicle's cargo.
The quiet lines: notes, the search field's placeholder, labels on the cards and the version.
How many lie in a stack, and a hotbar slot's count.
The tabs of the boxes: Uniform, Vest, Backpack, a vehicle's cargo.
Loads, free space and the values on the inspect and comparison cards.
The rounds on the weapons' cards and in their magazine slots: 30/30, 17/17.
The weapons' names on their cards: MX, P99.
The weight card: the kilograms, Light or Heavy and the next step.
The word Inventory at the top left.
Tints the caption tabs, chips, buttons, what lights under the mouse, bar tracks and picked rows.
Ready-made looks to start from. Changing a row afterwards makes it Custom.
Captions, names and labels, with their dimmer shades. Lightened where it would be hard to read.
Item colours are set per category in the setup (Categories).
How see-through the item tiles are. Their colours come from the setup, per category.
The window's title, the column titles, the headings, the name at the mouse and the cards' names. Can run as a gradient.
The rest of the room - click to show it or to fold it away again
Size of cells, pictures and text (default 1.1).\nAlso set live in the window:\nthe size button in the header.
A vest, uniform, helmet or backpack at the mouse shows how it differs from the one you wear.\nGreen is better, red worse.
Writes build, redraw and frame timings and search and drag costs to the RPT, for FPS reports.\nOff in play.
Seconds the hands are busy dropping one item (drop key, Drop in the menu), one after another. 0 drops at once.
Time to put on or take off
Seconds the hands need to put an item on or take it off.\n0 is instant; dragging never waits.
Time to move to another container
Seconds the hands are busy moving one item to another container (quick move, group moves). 0 moves at once; a drag never waits.
Where the loot column opens: beside your storage,\nor at the right edge with your storage moving aside.
Left of my storage - my storage stays put
Right of my storage - my storage moves aside
A thin fill bar on magazines that are not full.
Rounds left as text ("17/30") on magazine tiles.\nOff: the fill bar alone.
A movement key pressed while looting or searching closes the window and stops the search.\nOff: movement keys do nothing in the window.
Rows per page of a container

Rows shown at a time for tall crates and vehicles (default 10).
0 or 40 shows everything. Loot only.
Also set live in the window:
the size button in the header.
Your colours as text. Copy to share,\npaste to wear someone else's.\nForced by the server: everyone gets them.
Who may take items out of a living person's uniform, vest and backpack, and put items in.\nNobody: the gear can only be looked at.
Tell a player who goes through their gear;\nnearby players hear ACE's zipper.
Whose gear opens fully while alive; others only by the backpack.\nUnconscious players always open fully.
Who may take off what a living person wears.\nBodies can always be stripped.
Players get the colour panel in the header.\nOff: everyone sees the default look.
What a body carries stays a sealed "Unsearched" box until it has been searched - also once dropped.
Crates and vehicles stay "Unsearched" until searched.\nSkip one in Eden or with Zeus.
A pile on the ground stays a sealed "Unsearched" box until it has been searched.
A box is searched once its Search button is clicked; several boxes can search at the same time.\nOff: every box starts searching by itself.
What a living person carries stays sealed until searched, awake, unconscious or captive.\nBodies follow "Search bodies".
Times the search time per cell for a backpack, worn or lying anywhere: 1 the same, 2 twice as long.\n0 shows a backpack's contents at once.
Search time factor for bodies (1 normal, 2 double, 0 instant).
Times the search time per cell for a crate or box: 1 the same, 2 twice as long.\n0 shows a crate's contents at once.
Times the search time per cell for a pile on the ground (needs "Search the ground"): 1 the same.\n0 shows the ground at once.
Search time factor for uniforms (1 normal, 2 double, 0 instant).
Search time factor for vehicles (1 normal, 2 double, 0 instant).
Times the search time per cell for a vest, worn or lying anywhere: 1 the same, 2 twice as long.\n0 shows a vest's contents at once.
Seconds to search one cell of loot; bigger items take longer.\n0 shows everything at once.
Crates and vehicles placed with Zeus are searched like any other.\nOff: they show their loot at once. Needs "Search crates and vehicles" on.
Show piles and crates within reach in the loot column.\nOff: only what you opened.
Players nearby hear looting (10 to 20 m).\nOff: only the looter hears it.

Size of the window's words, on top of
the tile scale (default 1).
Also set live in the window:
the size button in the header.
Short item names on tiles.\nOff: picture only, the name shows on hover.
Whether the drop key and Drop in the menu take the hands' time (time to drop an item). Off drops at once; a drag never waits.
Goggles, NVGs, binoculars and weapon parts take the hands' time too.\nOff: instant.
Whether the quick move, a double click and a group quick move take the hands' time. Off moves them at once; a drag never waits.
Uniform, vest, backpack and helmet wait
Whether putting on and taking off a uniform, vest, backpack or headgear takes the hands' time. Off does it at once; a drag never waits.
Every size back to its default
Saved in your CBA addon options. Point at a size to see what it does.
Nothing you loot right now is full enough for pages - open a well-filled crate or vehicle to see it.
Loot only: a crate or vehicle filled with more rows than this shows them in pages. All: no pages.
The window's words, on top of the tiles: larger words on small tiles, or smaller ones.
The cells and item pictures, and the words with them. Capped where the columns would not fit.
Next click: sorts everything in here by name
Next click: sorts everything in here by size, largest first
Next click: sorts everything in here by kind - weapons, ammo, gear, medical, the rest
Next click: sorts everything in here by weight, heaviest first
Sound volumes (right click: mute or unmute all)
